_comment: Race mode (card 06). gridSec = time on the grid before the lights; lights come on one per lightIntervalSec, then a random hold of holdMinSec..holdMaxSec before lights out. Throttle above jumpStartThrottle while the lights are on = jump start (flagged on the results, no penalty yet). finishTimeoutSec = how long after the winner the race waits for stragglers. timingLineReachM: timing lines (practice and race) also count a crossing this far past either end, like a loop across the run-off, so a car running wide where a line meets the track edge still gets timed.
_comment_quali: Race weekend: qualifying lasts qualiSec; AI cars leave the pit lane one every qualiReleaseGapSec (the player is free at once). Best valid lap sets the grid; a car on a timed lap when the clock runs out may finish it (finishTimeoutSec caps the wait). points = championship points for P1, P2, ... in a race. qualiFastForward = sim speed-up once your own qualifying session is over (End session, or after the flag). qualiFuelKg = fuel everyone starts qualifying with (light, like real qualifying); a pit stop in qualifying tops back up to this, not a full tank.
_comment_equal: equalise: in Equal performance mode (race setup), how far each team's six stat multipliers move toward 1.0 (1 = identical cars, Motus included). Spec and setup still apply on top. Team stats mode ignores it.
